newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-INJURED PICHOT TO MISS PUMAS TOUR OF ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED PICHOT TO MISS PUMAS TOUR OF ENGLAND.

text.p: Pumas scrum-half Agustin Pichot, who impressed British crowds with his performances for the Barbarians at the end of last season, will miss Argentina's tour of England starting on November 20 because of injury.

Pichot damaged a cruciate ligament playing for Club Atletico San Isidro in a domestic first division match in Buenos Aires three weeks ago and underwent surgery, a source close to the Argentine rugby team said on Thursday.

Speaking during the launch of the Air France Rugby Sevens tournament this weekend in Paris, the source said he did not know how long Pichot, who has been courted by English clubs, would be out of action.
